segments.zh: 所以让我们最后一次听我们的对话。

segments.en: Let's review everything and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 让我们回顾一下一切，我们会回来的。

segments.en: You want to go get a facial with me today?
segments.zh: 你今天想和我一起去做面部护理吗？

segments.en: Dude, what are you talking about?
segments.zh: 哥们，你在说什么？

segments.en: Only girls do that.
segments.zh: 只有女孩子才那样做。

segments.en: Not at all.
segments.zh: 一点也不。

segments.en: Guys also get facials, manicures and pedicures.
segments.zh: 男士也会做面部护理、美甲和足部护理。

segments.en: There's nothing wrong with looking after your skin and looking good.
segments.zh: 护理皮肤、让自己看起来精神一点，没什么不对。

segments.en: True.
segments.zh: 确实。

segments.en: So what should they do to you at your beauty spa?
segments.zh: 那么他们应该在你的美容水疗中心对你做什么呢？

segments.en: Well, first they exfoliate my face, getting rid of all the dead skin.
segments.zh: 先给脸去角质，清除死皮。

segments.en: Then I get a face mask with nutrients that keep my skin healthy and young.
segments.zh: 然后敷上有滋养成分的面膜，让皮肤保持健康年轻。

segments.en: Afterwards, they apply some moisturizer and you leave feeling like a million bucks.
segments.zh: 接着涂保湿霜，出来时整个人都神清气爽。

segments.en: That doesn't really sound like something I would be interested in.
segments.zh: 听起来我没什么兴趣。

segments.en: In any case, I just wash my face every night and use sunscreen during the day.
segments.zh: 反正我每天晚上洗脸，白天涂防晒霜就行。

segments.en: Well, you should come with me one day.
segments.zh: 改天跟我去一次吧。

segments.en: I'm sure you'll love it.
segments.zh: 我相信你会喜欢的。

segments.en: Uh, no.
segments.zh: 呃，还是不了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So facials, this sort of thing is commonly mostly associated with women.
segments.zh: 所以面部护理，这种事情通常主要与女性有关。

segments.en: But as we saw in the dialogue, more and more men are actually taking care of their skin and their appearance.
segments.zh: 但正如我们在对话中看到的那样，越来越多的男人实际上是在照顾他们的皮肤和外表。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: This might have been traditionally a woman's event, going to the spa, having a girl's day at the spa.
segments.zh: 这可能是传统上女性的活动，去水疗中心，在水疗中心度过一个女孩节。

segments.en: You're right, Marco.
segments.zh: 你是对的，马可。

segments.en: A lot of men like to do this.
segments.zh: 很多男人喜欢这样做。

segments.en: Just because you get a manicure doesn't mean you have to have pink fingernails.
segments.zh: 仅仅因为你得到修指甲并不意味着你必须有粉红色的指甲。

segments.en: You can actually just have your nails taken care of and cleaned and cut and your cuticles taken care of.
segments.zh: 实际上，您可以只照顾好您的指甲、清洁和切割，并照顾好您的角质层。

segments.en: So it feels really nice.
segments.zh: 所以感觉真的很好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Actually, it's a common new trend that we've even heard in the news about.
segments.zh: 实际上，这是我们甚至在新闻中听到的一种常见的新趋势。

segments.en: And the term that men are labeled with when they take excessive care of their skin and their appearance, they say they're metrosexuals.
segments.zh: 以及男人在过度照顾自己的皮肤和外表时被贴上标签的术语，他们说他们是都市人。

segments.en: Metrosexual.
segments.zh: 都市性爱。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Now, this is a man who, like you say, likes to dress nicely, takes care of his hair, has nice skin, someone who really takes care of their body.
segments.zh: 现在，就像你说的那样，喜欢穿得漂亮，照顾他的头发，有很好的皮肤，一个真正照顾自己身体的人。

segments.en: And it's different from being a homosexual, for example, where maybe that's a stereotype that we have, where we say, oh, well, some people who are homosexual like to dress very well and take care of their skin.
segments.zh: 例如，这与同性恋不同，例如，这可能是我们的刻板印象，我们说，哦，好吧，有些同性恋的人喜欢穿得很好，照顾好自己的皮肤。

segments.en: Metrosexual people, men, are straight.
segments.zh: 都市性的人，男人，是异性恋。

segments.en: They're not gay.
segments.zh: 他们不是同性恋。

segments.en: But they still like to do these things, to go to the spa or to take care of their appearances.
segments.zh: 但他们仍然喜欢做这些事情，去水疗中心或照顾他们的外表。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a very interesting topic, specifically nowadays, where this type of thing is more and more common.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的话题，特别是现在，这种事情越来越普遍。

segments.en: And yet still in many places and cultures, it's very much taboo.
segments.zh: 然而，在许多地方和文化中，这仍然是非常禁忌的。

segments.en: Obviously, being manly man associated with that is, you know, you don't really take care of your appearance.
segments.zh: 显然，作为有男子气概的男人，你知道，你并没有真正照顾好自己的外表。

segments.en: You know, you wake up and you still look kind of messy and half asleep or, you know, guy has scars and beards and stuff.
segments.zh: 你知道，你醒来，你仍然看起来有点凌乱，半睡着，或者，你知道，家伙有伤疤和胡须之类的东西。

segments.en: So you don't really associate it much.
segments.zh: 所以你并没有真正将其关联起来。

segments.en: But it's very interesting to see these types of different cultural aspects.
segments.zh: 但看到这些类型的不同文化方面非常有趣。

segments.en: So we would like to know if in your culture, your country, this is a common practice.
segments.zh: 所以我们想知道在你的文化中，你的国家，这是一种常见的做法。

segments.en: Is it acceptable or is it very, very rare?
segments.zh: 它是可以接受的还是非常非常罕见的？

segments.en: And if you go to the beauty spa, whether you're a man or a woman, what's your favorite service?
segments.zh: 如果你去美容水疗中心，无论你是男人还是女人，你最喜欢的服务是什么？

segments.en: Do you like the facials?
segments.zh: 你喜欢面部护理吗？

segments.en: Do you like the pedicures?
segments.zh: 你喜欢修脚吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
